title: Cosmic Octopus Over Ruins
description: A surreal psychedelic scene depicts a giant purple octopus-like creature with a single horn and many eyes, floating within a swirling cosmic vortex of orange and black. Below, a ruined city with crumbling buildings and a green 'KEEP OUT' sign is overtaken by lush vegetation and oversized colorful flowers, while rows of identical white translucent humanoid figures stand in formation on red ground as orange liquid drips from the creature's tentacles.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a giant purple octopus creature with a single long horn and dozens of blue eyes, floating inside a swirling fiery cosmic vortex in a dark starry sky. The creature drips orange liquid from its tentacles over a post-apocalyptic ruined city being reclaimed by green vines and giant colorful flowers. In the foreground, multiple rows of identical white translucent humanoid figures stand in formation on blood-red ground. A green street sign reads KEEP OUT. Highly detailed, vibrant, mystical atmosphere.
